asr.full_text: I can't believe this. It is so cool. How do I open this door? Who are they? This is me. You will be more beautiful when I get older. Hold this. Hi everyone, my name is Mania, and I am from Kharkov. And my surprise is this. Since the first moment our child was brought into this flat, the kids have been very active. The most harmless thing was tearing through the wallpaper, but anyway, she was standing on her head and doing something. When Masha jumped off the luge, neighbors, especially the fifth floor, suffered a lot. I was very little when my mum took me to the show. You sat there on that spot! There you'd have better vision of me! All the relatives have to get there to watch. We sit and watch the show. Everyone is like, oh God, this is awful. It's really scary when the grand you are showing it to the elderly it is nothing but horror… When she feels tired she can bear it. She never cries. When she falls on her knees sometimes cry without a care. There are not many people who can make it till the end. Then a lot of people go out. I do not like such people. Everything will work out, you have to believe in yourself. – Hello! – Hi. – Who are you? – I'm Maria Shevchenko. I'm from Kharkov. I'm 14. You are Maria Shevchenko, and this is surreal gymnastics, isn't it? – We'll see. Quiet, quiet! Who has turned this music on for free, and how crazy I am. She flew away! I couldn't even see it happening. That's a surprise. Who did that? And they're gone! Unbelievable. Oh my God. It's really scary just now Look guys, it is very just without a safety rope. I'm not scared! Oh my God the Don't Scare Me Do you have a cardio stimulator? I'm afraid of this trick, guys! Here I am Great! Great! Great! I can't stand my legs. Thank you! I'm supposed to share my shirt with you because of you! I was afraid of heights, you scared me like this a couple of times, especially at the end. I'm saying yes to your sparks! Thank you very much! I thought my heart would stop there, when you fell, and it would be so easy. I could not even stand, my legs were gone. Bravo, bravo. What height did you work at the top? 10,900 meters! I say so! Thank you very much. Rida! Thank you. You did it! I would paint on the mountain, if it were real. She is hot. I love it, when you like this and you get scary. Our little participants are so eager! Be sure to visit our YouTube channel «Ukraine has talent of children» Vote, like and you will be happy.
